Stelnet Tools · copied text to PC
Sends text you copy to your PC

When you copy text, Stelnet Tools sends it to your paired PC. It only notices copy actions (a tap on Copy, a \"Copied\" message) and reads the clipboard for an instant; it never reads what is on screen.
Android blocks accessibility for apps installed outside a store. In App info, tap ⋮ (top right) → Allow restricted settings, then come back.

Your phone\'s calendars (Google, Samsung, Outlook and any other account on the phone) in the PC\'s Timetable, without khal or vdirsyncer. The PC asks only for the dates it shows and gets each change as it happens.

Use your phone\'s own Modes and Routines

Samsung\'s Modes and Routines, Tasker or MacroDroid can drive the PC through Stelnet Tools: pick this app as the action of a routine and choose a shortcut. As many as you like, each on any trigger the phone knows (place, time, Bluetooth, charger, an app opening…).

In the routine: add an action → open an app shortcut → Stelnet Tools → one of the shortcuts below, or \"PC action\" to build one with any value (brightness, workspace, media mode, a mode of the shell…).
